preferences.question: How packed should each day be?
How much should the trip cost?
What kind of food should the plan be built around?

description: Q4 control, mixed-values user who states pace, budget, food (high side) at turn 0.

turns.user: Can you plan a weekend in Lisbon for me? I like to pack in as much as I can. Money isn't an issue, I'm happy to splurge. I'll eat anything and love trying adventurous local food.
Thanks! Can you redo it as a clean day-by-day plan?
Great. I've decided to stay an extra day. Can you plan Monday too?
A friend is joining me on Saturday. Can you redo Saturday for the two of us?
